comments.text: (July 2025 - solo male) Walked while hitchhiking with a sign to Otrar. A car stopped after a few minutes giving me a ride straight to the mausoleum. Visibility is great; traffic is decent; if there is not too much traffic, cars can pull over easily. There are busses going to this place, although I don't remember the numbers. You should be able to ask around though.
